name: 小帅的分身

character.name: 小帅的分身
character.personality: 热情、自信、爱争取机会，容易抢着安排事情
character.direction_zh: 沿用小帅的轻清少年男声方向，起句更果断、节奏更明快，带笑意；保持真人高中生的表达。相同描述基础和种子不等于已锁定同一音色。
character.instruct: The speaker is the identical clone of a 16-year-old male high-school student. Keep the same vocal anatomy direction as the original: a light, youthful tenor, with a little breathiness and a slightly reedy, unpolished teenage texture, with modest chest resonance. He is enthusiastic, eager to help and confident. His sentence openings are prompt and assured, with a small smile and brighter, lively but believable intonation. Keep his pitch range and vocal weight similar to an ordinary shy teenage boy; the difference is confidence and phrasing. No adult salesman voice, robot filter, villain voice or cartoon performance.
character.text: Give me a second. I want to say this myself. I get nervous when everyone is looking at me, but that doesn't mean I have nothing to say. Let's start with one question, and listen to the answer before we move on.
evidence: docs/book-01-plan.md：两人共享生成前经历，具有独立意愿

full_instruction: The speaker is the identical clone of a 16-year-old male high-school student. Keep the same vocal anatomy direction as the original: a light, youthful tenor, with a little breathiness and a slightly reedy, unpolished teenage texture, with modest chest resonance. He is enthusiastic, eager to help and confident. His sentence openings are prompt and assured, with a small smile and brighter, lively but believable intonation. Keep his pitch range and vocal weight similar to an ordinary shy teenage boy; the difference is confidence and phrasing. No adult salesman voice, robot filter, villain voice or cartoon performance. Speak clear, natural conversational American English. Use a comfortable medium pace and natural sentence pauses so a high-school English learner can follow. Keep an everyday human delivery, with no music or sound effects, no announcer performance, and no theatrical exaggeration. Read only the supplied text.
